resources.string: ScamCheck can read incoming SMS so it can warn you before you reply. The check runs on the phone. The message is sent to your ScamCheck server only if you tap Check with AI. You can say no and still paste a message.

SMS access is off. Paste a message, or turn it on later in system settings. On Android 13 and newer, sideloaded apps need Allow restricted settings in App info before the SMS permission can be granted.
